display_long_description:
**08/08/2026: NEW UPDATE IS LIVE - JUMP IN AND CHECK IT OUT!**

Zero Caliber: Reloaded is the all-in-one VR military FPS: play solo or in 4-player Co-op, jump into PvP, survive enemy waves, fight zombies, and explore community-made content with native mod support.

# ◀ SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN ▶

Fight through 20+ story-driven missions in a war-torn, dystopian US as an OSA soldier and rise through the ranks to save what remains.

[media]

# ◀ CO-OP & PVP ▶

Play the full campaign with up to 3 friends (or strangers) using built-in voice chat, or battle with, and against other players in Gun Game, TDM, DM, and more on dedicated servers.

# ◀ SURVIVAL & ZOMBIE MODES ▶

Defend key objectives in Survival, or take on the undead across 3 Zombie maps with limited ammo - for a change. ;)

[media]

# ◀ CUSTOMIZE YOUR GEAR ▶

Choose from 40+ firearms and melee weapons, 50+ attachments, and 100+ unlockable skins. Customize your weapons in real time and build a setup that fits your playstyle.

[media]

# ◀ MOD SUPPORT ▶

Play community-made missions and PvP maps, or create your own. Details on our Discord.

[media]

# ◀ FUTURE UPDATES ▶

More updates are on the way, so stay tuned!

- Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/xrealgames
- Support: support@xrealgames.com

# ◀ THE SEQUEL ▶

If you like Zero Caliber: Reloaded, you'll LOVE the sequel: 
https://www.meta.com/experiences/zero-caliber-2/6072194326150034/

[media]

# ◀ OUR NEW GAME ▶

Check out and wishlist COVR, our new upcoming tactical shooter here: 
https://www.meta.com/experiences/covr/26564910626481959/ 
[media]
